Supreme Court questions High Court rape definition; other courts handle related cases

The Supreme Court has taken a critical view of a High Court order that suggested removing a woman's salwar and pressing her chest did not constitute an attempt to rape. Meanwhile, various High Courts and child rights panels are addressing other cases involving sexual assault allegations, including permitting pregnancy termination for a minor rape victim and upholding FIRs against police officers in rape cases.
